flintlock.title: Flintlock
flintlock.description: A chunky stylized sky-pirate flintlock pistol, a hand-painted adventure-game prop. A long thick steel barrel in blue-grey steel (#334b5a), octagonal at the breech and round toward the muzzle, with two brass barrel bands and a brass muzzle ring; a dark walnut stock (#825635) whose thick grip drops nearly straight down from the lock, with only a slight backward curve, and ends in a rounded brass butt cap (#e9b855); a large brass trigger guard; a brass lock plate on the right side carrying a big oversized steel hammer holding a flint, and a brass priming pan; a brass ramrod pipe under the barrel with a pale wooden ramrod. Exaggerated, toy-like, readable proportions: thick barrel, big hammer, big trigger guard, a clean unbroken silhouette, no thin fragile parts, no straps, cords, tassels or chains, no engraved lettering.

scatter.title: Scatter
scatter.description: A chunky stylized sky-pirate blunderbuss pistol, a hand-painted adventure-game prop. A short thick barrel in blue-grey steel (#334b5a), octagonal at the breech and round in the middle, that swells forward into a big wide trumpet-flared brass muzzle (#e9b855) with a thick rolled brass rim, the mouth of the flare nearly as tall as the lock; one brass barrel band where the steel meets the flare; a dark walnut stock (#825635) with a fat rounded wooden fore-end running forward under the barrel to just behind the flare, and a thick grip that drops nearly straight down from the lock with only a slight backward curve and ends in a rounded brass butt cap; a large brass trigger guard; a brass lock plate on the right side carrying a big oversized steel hammer holding a flint, and a brass priming pan; no ramrod. The flared barrel is a little over half the gun's length. Exaggerated, toy-like, readable proportions: fat barrel, huge flared muzzle, big hammer, big trigger guard, a clean unbroken silhouette, no thin fragile parts, no straps, cords, tassels or chains, no engraved lettering.

repeater.title: Repeater
repeater.description: A chunky stylized sky-pirate repeating carbine, a hand-painted adventure-game prop: a compact long gun (a short rifle) with a shoulder stock. A short thick barrel in blue-grey steel (#334b5a), octagonal at the breech and round toward the muzzle, about half the gun's length, ending in a brass muzzle ring (#e9b855) with a small brass front sight; a squared boxy steel receiver behind the barrel with a brass rear sight block on top; a brass lock plate on the right side carrying a big oversized steel hammer holding a flint, and a brass priming pan; a fat teal-painted steel box magazine (#277f80) with a brass base plate hanging straight down under the receiver, directly in front of the trigger guard and behind the fore-end, about as tall as the receiver; a large brass trigger guard; a dark walnut stock (#825635) with a fat rounded wooden fore-end running forward under the barrel to about two thirds of the barrel's length, held by two brass barrel bands, a thick wooden pistol grip dropping down behind the trigger, and a short straight wooden shoulder stock ending in a brass butt plate. Exaggerated, toy-like, readable proportions: thick barrel, big hammer, big teal magazine, big trigger guard, a clean unbroken silhouette, no thin fragile parts, no sling, straps, cords, tassels or chains, no engraved lettering.

burst.title: Burst
burst.description: A chunky stylized sky-pirate burst-fire repeating carbine, a hand-painted adventure-game prop: a long gun with a shoulder stock, noticeably longer than a short rifle. A long thick barrel in blue-grey steel (#334b5a), octagonal at the breech and round toward the muzzle, about two thirds of the gun's length, ending in a brass muzzle ring (#e9b855) with a small brass front sight; a squared boxy steel receiver behind the barrel with a brass rear sight block on top; a brass lock plate on the right side carrying a big oversized steel hammer holding a flint, and a brass priming pan; a narrow curved steel magazine (#334b5a) with a brass base plate hanging down under the receiver, directly in front of the trigger guard and behind the fore-end, a little taller than the receiver and curving gently back toward the grip at its bottom; a large brass trigger guard; a dark walnut stock (#825635) with a fat rounded wooden fore-end running forward under the barrel to about half the barrel's length, held by three brass barrel bands, a thick wooden pistol grip dropping down behind the trigger, and a short straight wooden shoulder stock ending in a brass butt plate. Exaggerated, toy-like, readable proportions: long thick barrel, big hammer, big curved magazine, big trigger guard, a clean unbroken silhouette, no thin fragile parts, no sling, straps, cords, tassels or chains, no engraved lettering.

longshot.title: Longshot
longshot.description: A chunky stylized sky-pirate long rifle, a hand-painted adventure-game prop: a very long gun with a shoulder stock, the longest of the pirate's guns, a marksman's rifle. A very long thick barrel in blue-grey steel (#334b5a), octagonal at the breech and round toward the muzzle, about three quarters of the gun's length, ending in a brass muzzle ring (#e9b855) with a small brass front sight; a squared boxy steel receiver behind the barrel; a big brass telescopic sight on top — a fat dark blue-steel tube (#233f50) with brass end rings and a pale cyan glass lens (#78d5df) at its front, held in two tall brass mounts above the receiver and the rear of the barrel, the telescope the tallest part of the gun; a brass lock plate on the right side carrying a big oversized steel hammer holding a flint, and a brass priming pan; a stubby steel bolt handle with a round brass ball knob sticking straight out of the right side of the receiver, just above and behind the lock plate; a large brass trigger guard; a dark walnut stock (#825635) with a fat rounded wooden fore-end running forward under the barrel to about half the barrel's length, held by three brass barrel bands, a thick wooden pistol grip dropping down behind the trigger, and a short straight wooden shoulder stock ending in a brass butt plate. No magazine. Exaggerated, toy-like, readable proportions: very long thick barrel, big telescope, big hammer, big ball-knob bolt handle, big trigger guard, a clean unbroken silhouette, no thin fragile parts, no sling, straps, cords, tassels or chains, no engraved lettering.
